correctness.rationale: The known homotopy theorem rigorously gives vanishing reduced homology except degree two. Its complete orbit list comprises single edges, both two-edge types, C3/P4 triples, and C4 quadruples, with no higher cells. Signed permutation characters for each local orbit are directly calculated on S3 and S4; the key S4 characters (3,1,-1,0,-1) and (12,0,-4,0,0) are checked from the actual simplices. The equivariant Euler identity then gives \(h_{n-2}h_2-h_{n-3}s_{(2,1)}+2h_{n-4}s_{(2,1,1)}-h_n\). The horizontal-strip Pieri expansions establish all \(n\ge6\) and recomputation gives \(n=4,5\). The independent standalone finite verifier exhausts \(4\le n\le7\) graph faces to size five and character traces on all conjugacy classes; finite computations are corroborative, not the source of the universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The complete rational homology of a natural infinite graph-complex family is refined from a mere rank into an explicit stable four-Specht-module decomposition. Low-\(n\) transition and the absence of trivial summands quantify symmetry not recoverable from the established wedge count. This is a motivated structural calculation of a natural automorphism representation, not an arbitrary graph slice or a restatement of a known Betti number.
